subject: [AMBER] ABMD with RMSD and RoG: ** NFE-Error ** : Cannot read &colvar namelist!

messages.author: Feng Pan
messages.body:
Hi, Diego
It should be cv_ni instead of cv_i in the R_OF_GYRATION
Feng
On Mon, Jul 20, 2020 at 9:38 AM Diego Morone <diego.morone.irb.usi.ch>
wrote:
